title: Scaled Life
description:
Scaled Life - the more lives the bigger you get

Scaled life is a spin off of last life by Grian
body:
scaled life is a last life plugin made by Arnxld._. on discord

- this is created for MRBEBB

The more lfies the bigger you get with Scaled life.

commands:
- setlives <player> <number of lives>
- rollboogeyman - Makes someone boogeyman (kill anyone in sepecific time)
- rolllives - Roll lives for all people
- givelife <player> - Give one of your lives to another player


settup

```
defaultlives: 3
boogeymanSessionDurationMinutes: 1
minRollLives: 3
maxRollLives: 5
spawnProtectionDurationSeconds: 120
```

Set up spawn protection, duration in minutes and max and min roll lives and default lives the player had joined with in `Config.yml`
